notes.title: AMD Driver Solution
notes.content:
Operation AMD Driver Solution was a success!

I have a welcome follow up to the previously mentioned [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/311340/announcements/detail/38631087383986044]AMD Driver Issue[/url] we encountered earlier.

By operating the "AMD Catalyst 15.8 Beta," which should be available in the following [url=http://support.amd.com/en-us/kb-articles/Pages/latest-catalyst-windows-beta.aspx]link[/url] on Aug 31st 2015 (currently version is 15.6) Players should be able to remedy the driver issues the team discovered earlier.

* The user will need to manually download and install it, as it is still a β version.
* Since it is the β version, and it's presented 'as is without a full guarantee from AMD,' we ask that the users install under their own risk, and possibly backup their system.

We hope this addresses the issues of many players and thank you for your patience as AMD arrived at a solution.

-KJPDev

notes.title: Metal Gear Solid V: Ground Zeroes PATCH NOTES 1/23/2015
notes.content:
This is the liberty we've won for ourselves: Steam Forums! 
 
We've incorporated the now player-tested, Big Boss approved Beta test into an official patch. Now without signing up for the optional Beta process every user can take advantage of the repairs, safeguards and improvements made to the release version of Metal Gear Solid V: Ground Zeroes. Make me feel alive again!

The patch notes are small but significant adding the following:

- When the Camera Y Axis is set to Reverse, the camera movement with the mouse will reflect the change 
- Under some conditions, there was a "Low Memory" error a few minutes after launching the game. This issue has been fixed. 
- When some USB devices were connected the game didn't launch. This issue has been fixed. 

Additionally the patch also has incorporated some community identified bugs:

- Certain gunfire animations weren't properly displayed. This issue has been fixed. 
- The animation for empty shells ejecting during gunfire wasn't properly displayed. This issue has been fixed. 
- The Windows Screensaver, under certain conditions, interrupted gameplay. This issue has been addressed.

Please do inform us if you run into any new errors or problems with the addition of this patch. 

While no additional major patches are planned for implementation we’ll continue to evaluate the discussions here and work to make adjustments if necessary. 

We never felt truly alive unless we were staring bugs in the face. Thank you immensely for your assistance in reporting concerns and helping us confirm them fixed.

-KJPDev

notes.title: Beta Implemented Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Some players have reported various bugs in the game that the team has worked on repairing since they were first reported.

The team has just recently launched a Beta version of the game client. You can download and try out this version which includes a recent patch to correct for the following issues specifically:

- When the Camera Y Axis is set to Reverse, the camera movement with the mouse will reflect the change
- Under some conditions, there was a "Low Memory" error a few minutes after launching the game. This issue has been fixed.
- When some USB devices were connected the game didn't launch. This issue has been fixed.

To download the Beta version, right click the entry for Metal Gear Solid V: Ground Zeroes in your Steam Library, and select Properties then click the tab for Beta.

If you've previously run into these issues, try the Beta version and check to see if any of the above issues you've experienced still occur. We'll keep checking the discussion forums, and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/311340/discussions/0/619574421348138259/]this thread[/url] for your continued feedback on these issues to confirm they've been resolved.

Thank you for your patience and help this holiday, and we hope you all have a Happy New Year!

-KJPDev
